user.title: Connect to your UniFi UNAS
user.description: Read-only monitoring over the local console API. Nothing is installed on the NAS.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the UNAS console.
data_description.tls_mode: UniFi consoles serve a self-signed certificate. Pinning records the one it serves now and refuses any other. Choose CA verification only if you installed a certificate from a real authority.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UniFi UNAS
reconfigure.description: Update the host, port, TLS or authentication for this UNAS. It must remain the same device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the UNAS console.
data_description.tls_mode: UniFi consoles serve a self-signed certificate. Pinning records the one it serves now and refuses any other. Choose CA verification only if you installed a certificate from a real authority.

tls_fingerprint.title: Trust this certificate
tls_fingerprint.description:
The console at this address is serving a certificate with the SHA-256 fingerprint below. Compare it with the one shown by the console itself if you can, then continue to accept it. From then on this integration refuses any other certificate.

`{fingerprint}`

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create an API key in the UniFi OS UI. It grants read-only access to storage, disks and system telemetry (it cannot read users or shares).

password.title: Local account
password.description: Use a least-privilege local account. This also exposes shares and snapshots.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi UNAS
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials are no longer valid. Enter them again.

error.insufficient_permissions: This credential lacks permission to read the required data.
error.cert_mismatch: The console presented a different certificate than the one saved. Either it was reissued, or something is impersonating the console.

abort.wrong_device: The credentials belong to a different UNAS.

init.title: Options
init.description: Control actions send state-changing requests to the NAS. Leave off for read-only monitoring. They require username/password auth (an owner account for power and firmware); an API key cannot perform them.

data.enable_controls: Enable control actions (reboot, shut down, install updates)

error.controls_need_session: Control actions require username/password authentication. Reconfigure the integration with a local account to enable them.

not_permitted.message: The UNAS account is not permitted to perform this action. Power and firmware actions require an owner/admin account.

auth_failed.message: Authentication with the UNAS failed; re-authenticate the integration.

action_failed.message: The UNAS could not complete the action{detail}.

share_gone.message: That share is no longer present on the UNAS.

install_needs_controls.message: Enable control actions (with an owner account) to install updates.

confirm.title: Accept the new certificate?
confirm.description:
The console is presenting a certificate that does not match the one saved for it. This is expected if you reissued it or reset the console; if you did neither, do not accept it.

Saved:
`{expected}`

Now served:
`{got}`

abort.entry_not_found: This UniFi UNAS entry no longer exists.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the console to read its certificate. Try again when it is back online.

tls_insecure.title: UniFi UNAS connection is not verified

confirm.title: Start trusting one certificate?
confirm.description:
This connection to {host} accepts any certificate, so nothing confirms the host answering is your console. Continue to record the certificate it serves now and refuse any other.

`{fingerprint}`

abort.entry_not_found: This UniFi UNAS entry no longer exists.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the console to read its certificate. Try again when it is back online.
